mapper.select: SELECT C.STUDY_TITLE, A.MEM_ID, CASE A.STUDY_ROLL WHEN 'M' THEN '팀원' WHEN 'L' THEN '팀장' ELSE '알수없음' END AS STUDY_ROLE, B.MEM_NICK, B.MEM_EMAIL, A.STUDY_JOINEDDATE FROM STUDYMEMBER A INNER JOIN MEMBER B ON (A.MEM_ID = B.MEM_ID) INNER JOIN STUDY C ON (A.STUDY_ID = C.STUDY_ID) WHERE A.STUDY_ID = #{studyId}
SELECT A.STUDY_ROLL FROM STUDYMEMBER A INNER JOIN MEMBER B ON (A.MEM_ID = B.MEM_ID) WHERE A.STUDY_ID = #{studyId} AND B.MEM_LOGIN_ID = #{memLoginId}
